run.dataset_name: Apple FY2025 annual-report QA / curated 24-question development benchmark

methodology.recall_at_3: Macro-average page recall over answerable questions: unique annotated (document_name, physical 1-based page) pairs found in raw top-3 chunks / all annotated page pairs. It does not verify exact supporting passage. Search failures score zero; generation failures retain measured retrieval.
methodology.automatic_answer_accuracy: Preliminary regex check of final answer only, or explicit abstention for unanswerable questions. It does not establish semantic correctness.
methodology.reviewed_accuracy: Correct agent-adjudicated answers / all questions, including errors. Published only when every response has an explicit review note. Reviews are agent-assisted checks against gold answers, not independent human labels, and use no additional judge-model API calls.
methodology.refusals: Correct refusal rate = unanswerable explicit abstentions / all unanswerable; false refusal rate = answerable explicit abstentions / all answerable; abstention precision = correct explicit refusals / all explicit abstentions. Request errors never count as refusals and remain in rate denominators.
methodology.latency: Sequential single-run wall-clock seconds, no warmup excluded. Ask includes one query embedding/retrieval, generation when invoked, retries and final validation; excludes PDF indexing, HTTP and UI. Retrieval measures the same search inside ask, not a second search. p50/p95 use linear interpolation. Successful and failed ask latencies are reported separately.
methodology.scope: Small curated development benchmark, not an independent held-out estimate.
